description: Implementation of CMSIS RTOS v2 Event Flags using Zephyr kernel primitives, including creation, setting, clearing, waiting, retrieving name and deleting event flags.

methods.name: osEventFlagsNew
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new event flags object, returning its ID.

methods.name: osEventFlagsSet
methods.description: Sets specified event flags on an event flags object.

methods.name: osEventFlagsClear
methods.description: Clears specified event flags on an event flags object.

methods.name: osEventFlagsWait
methods.description: Waits for one or more event flags to become signaled, with options for wait-all or wait-any, and timeout.

methods.name: osEventFlagsGetName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of an event flags object.

methods.name: osEventFlagsGet
methods.description: Gets the current signal results (flags) of an event flags object.

methods.name: osEventFlagsDelete
methods.description: Deletes an event flags object, freeing associated resources.
